question: What is the bottom-line business quality, valuation reality, technical posture, and portfolio action for NKE as of November 20, 2026?

epigraph.quote: Iconic brands deserve patience only when price, cash flow, and trend leave a margin of safety; at $32.92, NKE offers none of the three.
epigraph.author: Institutional Research Desk

web_blocks.html: Executive Decision: We rate NKE REJECTED (TIER_0 — VALUATION, CASH_FLOW, TREND) for new capital. On our held Robinhood stake of 74.577319 shares, we issue EXIT_IMMEDIATELY via market order or tight 0.5% marketable limit on next open. At the $32.92 official close, that stake is worth $2,455.09. That represents a -$394.91 (-13.86%) unrealized loss and a 3.27% portfolio weight. We park 100% ($2,455.09) in USD Cash. The U.S. market sits in a 10-distribution-day Downtrend, while portfolio cash stands at just 3.38% of Net Worth.

Pass 1 kept business quality at CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL / PASS_WITH_WATCH. Yet the November 17 Investor Day (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1) hurt near-term expectations [32]. Guidance cut FY2027 revenue by high-single digits. Adjusted operating margin falls to ~6%, and adjusted EPS drops to $1.15–$1.35 [32]. Market-level growth was pushed to FY2029. Meanwhile, Pace's $2.5 billion cost savings moved into FY2029–FY2030 alongside ~$1.3 billion in restructuring charges [32]. Footnotes also exposed $15.5 billion in rigid endorsements and $2.70 billion in lease-adjusted net debt [36, 37]. Q1 FCF turned negative at -$64 million despite $684 million in tariff cash, and Swoosh, LLC controls 78.8% of Class A shares [36, 38].

Valuation and chart structure confirm zero margin of safety. At $32.92 ($32.94 TradingView tick), NKE trades at 26.3x FY2027 adjusted EPS midpoint ($1.25) [32, 42]. Even with a +32% FY2028 EPS rebound built into our Base Case ($1.65 at 7.0% EBIT margin), fair value sits at $32.20. Expected value sits at $32.73 across Bear ($23.50), Base ($32.20), and Bull ($43.00) cases. Meanwhile, shares remain locked in Stage 4 (CAP_REJECTED). Price sits 10.22% below the 50-day SMA ($36.69) and $0.95 above the $31.97 52-week low ahead of December 17 earnings [24, 42, 43].

web_blocks.takeaway: Across business momentum, cash conversion, forward valuation, and Stage 4 technicals, every pillar aligns behind rejecting new NKE exposure and exiting the Robinhood holding into cash.

book_paragraphs: This prologue outlines our November 20, 2026 underwriting of NIKE, Inc. For new capital, our verdict is REJECTED at TIER_0 on valuation, cash-flow strain, and broken trend structure. For our held Robinhood stake of 74.577319 shares worth $2,455.09 at $32.92 (-$394.91 or -13.86%, 3.27% of Net Worth), we issue EXIT_IMMEDIATELY via market order or tight 0.5% marketable limit and hold 100% of proceeds in USD cash.

Although NIKE retains strong North America wholesale momentum (+9% in Q1 FY2027), the November 17 Investor Day lowered FY2027 forecasts sharply. Revenue is guided down high-single digits, adjusted operating margin drops to ~6%, and adjusted EPS falls to $1.15–$1.35. Market-level growth is pushed to FY2029, while Pace's $2.5 billion cost savings shift into FY2029–FY2030 alongside ~$1.3 billion in restructuring costs. Our footnote check also revealed $15.5 billion in rigid endorsements, $2.70 billion in lease-adjusted net debt, -$64 million Q1 FCF despite tariff cash receipts, and Swoosh, LLC's 78.8% Class A control.

Paying 26.3x trough FY2027 adjusted earnings offers zero safety buffer when Base fair value sits at $32.20 (already assuming a +32% FY2028 EPS recovery) and probability-weighted expected value sits at $32.73 (spanning Bear $23.50 to Bull $43.00). With shares trapped in a Stage 4 downtrend—more than 10% below the 50-day average and 25% below the 200-day average ahead of December 17 earnings—exiting doubles portfolio cash from 3.38% to 6.65% in a 10-distribution-day market Downtrend. The chapters ahead trace NIKE's business history, supply-chain economics, balance-sheet commitments, valuation math, and action plan in full detail.

Why does a storied global athletics icon earn an immediate exit and a zero-percent new-capital allocation? Turnaround discipline begins by separating brand permanence from balance-sheet and earnings math. Management used its November 17, 2026 Investor Day under Full Stride Ahead to formalize a much slower financial reset than consensus once priced. Fiscal 2027 guidance calls for a high-single-digit revenue decline, compressed adjusted operating margins near six percent, and adjusted earnings of $1.15 to $1.35 per share excluding roughly $0.15 of Pace restructuring severance.

At a $32.92 closing price, investors still pay roughly 26.3 times the fiscal 2027 adjusted midpoint for a shrinking franchise that faces $22.8 billion in contractual purchase and endorsement commitments alongside negative Q1 fiscal 2027 free cash flow of -$64 million. Market-level revenue expansion and $2.5 billion in annualized Pace cost savings were pushed out to fiscal 2029 and fiscal 2030. Waiting across multiple years of off-price wholesale clean-up in a confirmed Stage 4 downtrend violates both downside protection and opportunity-cost discipline.
